summary: A scary, full of ice screams adventure with Tom and his neighbours!
description: Start a scary and full of screams adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of the new horror made by Death Park and Mimicry developers! 💣 Say hello to this horror game where you'll have to immerse yourself in a thrilling and exciting adventure together with the main characters! Children have been missing for a long time in Lakewitch, and you are destined to solve this creepy mystery. Who is the kidnapper, and why is he doing it? Where are the children disappearing to, and how to save them? You can solve all the puzzles and find out the answers...if you don't get scared and wake up your neighbor with ice screams! 💀 In this episode you meet your friend Harry, who has come up with a plan to save you and kids of your neighborhood from the kidnapper of children while you're waiting for the return of your parents. Together with him, you will try to fortify the tree house, so that the scary kidnapper will not get to you. On the way to your goal, puzzles, ice moments of fear, screams, unexpected twists and turns, and lots of fun await you! 😃🤘🏻 Horror Tale is similar to Ice Scream, Evil Nun and Hello Neighbor, but with an intriguing story that will unfold over several episodes. This horror game is an exciting, fun, and scary adventure to the neighborhood of America of the '90s! 👍 Features of the adventure puzzle game Horror Tale: ★ Mysterious and fascinating story ★ Scary antagonist that will make you scream and interesting neighbor characters ★ Puzzles, riddles, and items to search ★ 5 diverse locations ★ Nice stylized graphics ★ Original author's soundtrack 😈 Immerse with your friends and neighbors into a thrilling ice adventure in our full of screams multi-part horror series!
